# freshdesk_company (Data Source)

Look up a single company by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "freshdesk_company" "example" {
  # Singular data sources take the record ID.
  # id = "42"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Numeric identifier of the company to look up.

### Read-Only

- `account_tier` (String) Account tier of the company.
- `created_at` (String) When the company was created (RFC 3339).
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values keyed by field name.
- `description` (String) Description of the company.
- `domains` (Set of String) Email domains belonging to the company.
- `health_score` (String) Relationship strength.
- `industry` (String) Industry the company serves.
- `name` (String) Name of the company.
- `note` (String) Free-text note about the company.
- `renewal_date` (String) Contract renewal date (RFC 3339).
- `updated_at` (String) When the company was last changed (RFC 3339).
